report.description: The laboratory, test and patient, from the page 1 header

laboratory.description: The name of the laboratory that issued the report

test_name.description: The test profile name as printed, e.g. '1001 IgG Food Antibodies Profile'

specimen_type.description: The specimen type printed after the test name, e.g. 'Serum'

methodology.description: The assay methodology as printed after 'Methodology:'

patient_name.description: The patient name as printed after 'Patient:'

total_ige.description: The Total IgE panel on page 1

value.description: The Total IgE result, as a number

unit.description: The unit of the Total IgE result, from the reference range, e.g. 'kU/l'

reference_range.description: The reference range as printed, e.g. '<=114.0 kU/l'

within_reference_range.description: True if the result is printed in the Inside column, false if in the Outside column

food_results.description: Every food tested in the IgG Food Antibody Results grid on page 1, in the order printed, column by column

food.description: The food name as printed, e.g. 'Cow's milk'

category.description: The category heading the food is listed under, e.g. 'Dairy' or 'Nuts and Grains'

result.description: The IgG reactivity code printed beside the food: '0', 'VL', '1+', '2+' or '3+'

high_reactive_foods.description: The foods listed under '3+ High' in the Summary of IgG Test Results on page 2
